channel.title: AI Engineering — Nicholas Garcia
channel.description: AI Engineering: agent orchestration, fleet operations, and the tooling behind this site.

item.title: Fourteen Automations That Run Without Me
item.description: Fourteen automations that run on a schedule without supervision, the eight rules that keep them safe, and the four ways they broke.

item.title: The Mechanical Check Test
item.description: One question decides whether an agent may act alone: can a cheap mechanical check prove the result? Here is how that test is wired into a running daemon.

item.title: Review What Actually Runs
item.description: An agent that reviews code every night needs to know which code matters. Rank by what the machine actually executes, times how long since anyone looked.

item.title: A Security Check With No Model In It
item.description: Six checks, once a month, no model calls, read-only, and never print the secret. The most reliable job in my fleet is the one with no intelligence in it.

item.title: Ship the Read-Only Report First
item.description: How to automate something you care about — your contacts, your obligations — starting with a job that cannot write anything, and adding write access one proven phase at a time.
